note: Starting stats for Advanced mode. Only fields with a sourced number are listed: where a character differs from Isaac in a way no source stated numerically — Judas' short range, Cain's faster default fire — the field is left out rather than guessed at, and the character's note says so. Azazel is deliberately absent: his Brimstone is a continuous beam rather than tears, so damage x fire rate does not describe him and a number here would be wrong rather than merely rough. Values are quoted against Isaac, who is the game's own baseline.

characters.name: Isaac
characters.note: The baseline. 3.5 damage, 10 frames between tears, 2.73 tears a second.

characters.name: Judas
characters.note: A third more damage for a single heart container. Also shorter range than Isaac, which is not modelled here because no source gave a number for it.

characters.name: Cain
characters.note: Fast and hits harder, with one fewer heart. He also fires faster than Isaac by default, which is not modelled here for want of a number.

characters.name: Samson
characters.note: Slightly slower tears than Isaac, but they travel faster and he keeps all three hearts.

characters.name: Eve
characters.note: Starts at three quarters damage. Whore of Babylon lifts her back to 1.00 at low health, which this does not simulate.
